jobs.title: Mobile Apps
jobs.description: The 🔥 Podcast App | Video Editing & Recording App | Riverside Skip to main content Get started A phone-blown recording studio. Invite guests, record high-quality audio and video, and see all your recordings right from our app. REC Riverside. Now available in pocket size. REC Riverside. Now available in pocket size. Enjoy Riverside’s high-quality, local recording from mobile, without worrying about reception or coverage. Once done, you can view your full HD video and uncompressed audio tracks in your dashboard. Invite collaborators Copy/paste your studio link or email them directly from the app. Join sessions Set yourself up in the lobby with your equipment and background. Manage recordings View, share, and sort all your recordings in the dashboard. Any phone. Any OS. Anywhere you want. Use your iPad, iPhone, or Android - the mobile app adds more options for you to create content not on just on desktop. Doubles as a phone-menal webcam. Recording on your computer? Scan the QR code in the lobby’s dropdown menu and the app will turn your phone into a pro webcam. Editing, cut to size. A fresh yet instantly-familiar, detailed yet conveniently-quicker, editing experience. The built-in editor has a flexible display that you can change with a tap, plus basic editing tasks, but optimized for smaller screens and touch interface. And when you’re all done, just click export to save it, share it, or post it. Frequently Asked Questions How does Riverside’s mobile app compare to other podcast recording apps? Riverside’s mobile app records locally on your device instead of over the internet. This means you can always capture up to 4K video and 48kHz WAV audio even if your Wi-Fi drops, protecting your final file quality. ‍ Riverside also offers: Separate audio and video tracks for each guest, for maximum control in post-production. Progressive uploading to the cloud while you record, so you don’t have to wait for huge files after recording. A multicam option to use your phone as a second webcam for your desktop setup. Built-in video editing for trimming, captions, and basic edits. For more advanced editing, you can continue in the desktop editor. How do I invite collaborators on Riverside’s mobile app? To invite collaborators on Riverside’s mobile app, open your studio and share the invite link. ‍ From the homepage: ‍ Tap the menu in the top right. Select your Studio . Tap the three dots (…) . Choose “Invite to studio” . Copy the link or share it via WhatsApp, Slack, Messenger, or another app. Alternatively, you can also invite any collaborator during a recording by following these steps: Tap “+ Create” then “Record” to start a new recording. Tap the “Invite” button (people icon). Copy the link or share it via WhatsApp, Slack, Messenger, or another app. You can invite collaborators as guests or audience members. What are the best practices for recording podcasts with Riverside’s mobile app? To record a podcast with Riverside’s mobile app, use proper equipment, lighting, and recording settings. ‍ Best practices include: Use a phone that supports at least 1080p video. Record with the back camera instead of the front camera for better video quality. Connect an external microphone and use correct mic positioning for better audio quality. Stabilize your phone with a tripod. Wear headphones to prevent echo. Face natural light or a soft light source. Turn on airplane mode to avoid interruptions. These steps improve both video and audio quality. ‍ Learn more on: How to record a podcast on your phone How to record a podcast with your iPhone What are the pricing options for Riverside’s mobile app? Riverside’s mobile app offers free and paid plans. ‍ Free plan: Record in 720p and access the in-app and desktop editor. Mobile Plus plan ($9.99/month): Remove watermarks and export up to 4K video and WAV audio. ‍ Paid web plans (starting at $24/month): Unlock the desktop version with 4K recording, branding tools, AI features, audio enhancement, eye-gaze correction, and more. What are the system requirements for using Riverside’s mobile app? Riverside’s mobile app requires an iPhone or iPad running iOS 17.0 or later, or an Android device running Android 7.0 or later. ‍ You can use an iPhone or iPad with iOS 16.0 to access the studio, but you won’t be able to use the editor with these devices. ‍ Android tablets and older mobile devices are not supported. ‍ For best performance, use an iPhone X or newer, an iPad model older than 2017, or an Android 10.0 device or newer. Can Riverside integrate with other software tools? Yes, Riverside integrates with multiple tools to streamline your workflow. You can: Record, edit, and publish directly from the Spotify for Creators dashboard. One-click distribute your episodes to YouTube, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, and other popular podcast directories. Sync webinar registration and attendance data with HubSpot and Salesforce. Export clips to Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, Telegram, and WhatsApp. Export timeline XML files for editing in Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro. These integrations help automate publishing and collaboration. Does Riverside’s mobile app have external microphone support? Yes, Riverside’s mobile app supports external microphones that your device recognizes as an input source. ‍ On iOS 26 and later versions , you can use a wired or USB microphone with Bluetooth headphones for output. ‍ On Android and older iOS versions , you must use wired headphones when recording with an external microphone (no Bluetooth headphones). ‍ Connecting an external microphone to your Riverside’s mobile app is as easy as it sounds. Just plug it in, and Riverside recognizes it automatically. Can I use a teleprompter for vlogging with Riverside’s mobile app? Yes, Riverside’s mobile app includes a built-in teleprompter for vlogging. You can read your script while maintaining eye contact with the camera. ‍ To use it: Tap “+ Create” and start a recording. Tap the script icon to open the tele

It’s fantastic! I have not been sending newsletters about my podcast but now I have no excuse! Barbara Vokatis Honestly, I don’t know how I’ve been surviving without this. It makes creating content so much fun and really easy. Ruhi M It’s like having your own personal content team. Frequently Asked Questions What is Co-Creator? Co-Creator is Riverside’s AI editing and repurposing agent built directly into the editor. It helps you edit recordings, generate clips, and turn content into ready-to-share assets by simply chatting with it. How does Co-Creator compare to other video editing tools? Co-Creator differs from traditional video editing tools because it acts as an active AI partner inside your editor. Instead of editing manually, you can chat with Co-Creator to apply full edits, style your video, create clips, and even repurpose videos into assets. ‍ Co-Creator uses the context of your actual recording. You can prompt it to “ find the funniest moment” or “ write a LinkedIn post about this episode ”, and it generates outputs based on your video. How do I integrate Co-Creator into my existing workflow? You can integrate Co-Creator into your workflow by using it after recording to edit and repurpose your content in one place. It allows you to move from raw footage to finished assets without leaving your Riverside dashboard. ‍ For example, your workflow could look like this: Record or upload your content to Riverside. Open your project in the Editor . Open the Co-Creator chat sidebar. Enter a prompt, such as “ Write a short newsletter summarizing this episode .” Review and publish the generated output What types of videos can I create with Co-Creator? You can create many types of videos with Co-creator, including short clips, teaser videos, long-form videos, and highlight reels. ‍ Here are a few examples: Short social clips: Ask Co-Creator, " Make me a short clip for [insert social media] " to help you identify the best clips and adapt them to a specific social platform. Video teaser: Ask Co-Creator, " Make me a teaser featuring [insert topic] " to create a quick promo video that focuses on a topic you discussed. Highlight reels: Use Co-Creator to find key themes by asking " Find all mentions of [insert topic] " so you can compile them into a themed video. ‍ YouTube videos/Podcast episodes: Ask Co-Creator, " Enhance my episode’s audio, cut filler, fix eye gaze, and clean up pauses " to quickly polish your long-form videos in minutes. How can I optimize my videos specifically for Instagram using Co-Creator? You can optimize your videos for Instagram by prompting Co-Creator with specific Instagram-friendly instructions. You can ask it to generate short, fast-paced Reels, a hook, and even a supporting Instagram caption. ‍ Here are a few workflow examples: ‍ Making a quick Reel: Start by generating an Instagram Reel with Co-Creator using this prompt: “ Identify the best moments in the video and generate a 20-30 seconds long Instagram Reel with a fast hook in the first 1.5 seconds, and tight pacing. Cut filler, keep one clear takeaway. ” ‍ You can ask for multiple Reel variants with different hooks and the same core point. ‍ Cleaning up a clip: Co-Creator can help you refine and polish an existing clip. Just use this prompt: " Polish this 90 seconds clip by cutting it to 60 seconds, improving pace, and cleaning up filler words. Also, enhance audio, add styled video captions that use my brand kit, and fix eye gaze. " ‍ Creating social media assets: You ask Co-Creator to help you with the additional assets with this prompt: " Create an engaging Instagram caption for this episode. Include a hook in the first line, 3 bullet takeaways, and a CTA to comment with a question. Also, suggest 15 relevant, high-traffic hashtags. " How can I develop a unique brand voice with an AI content assistant? You can develop a unique brand voice with Co-Creator by personalizing its writing style inside the editor. Co-Creator allows you to define your tone, audience, and messaging preferences. To personalize: ‍ Step 1: Record or upload your content. ‍ Step 2: Open your project in the Editor . ‍ Step 3: Open the Co-Creator sidebar. ‍ Step 4: Click “Personalize” . ‍ Step 5: From the “Personalization” panel, you can explain what your show is about by typing it into the box.
